description: Per-instance, per-arm bounded fix->test neighbourhoods for the seed corpus. Ships what a judge needs to run the comparison tooling and to live-load any instance's arms into the engine — NOT the 4.0 GB working corpus (per-instance .scip indexes + full-arm graphs) used to build them.

neighbourhood_budget.note: induced_neighbourhood(maxLen=6). Arm A: 0/50 truncated (sparse, faithful to the full arm). Arm B: 47/50 truncated (arm B is ~4x denser; the maxLen-6 neighbourhood exceeds the 24k-edge budget).

id_bands.note: Both arms of every instance occupy disjoint id bands, so all shipped neighbourhoods coexist in one engine without id collisions; the manifest.jsonl fix/test ids address the loaded nodes directly.

layout.arms/manifest.jsonl: per-instance/per-arm node+edge counts, id band, and fix_site_ids/test_target_ids. The cache the comparison tooling read. All 50 instances.
layout.arms/path_stats.json: pinned live-engine answerability + bounded fix->test path counts per arm (the two-arm contrast `compare` renders). All 50 instances.
layout.arms/<instance_id>/nodes.ndjson.gz: both arms' neighbourhood Function nodes (band-disjoint), gzipped.
layout.arms/<instance_id>/edges.ndjson.gz: both arms' neighbourhood CALLS edges (band-disjoint), gzipped.
layout.annotations.json: per-instance fix-site and test-target function ids.
layout.resolved/*.json: the three published SWE-bench ground-truth resolved-sets.

provenance: SWE-bench Verified django instances. Arm A: tree-sitter name-matched call graph (Aider / RepoGraph / LocAgent style). Arm B: scip-python / pyright type-resolved. Both built at each instance base_commit with the gold test_patch applied (solution patch NOT applied). Distilled from data/instances/arms/ by scripts/distil_shipped.py.
not_shipped: data/instances/arms/<id>/index.scip (~67 MB each, the pyright SCIP index) — regeneration input
data/instances/arms/<id>/{arm_a,arm_b}/ full graphs beyond the maxLen-6 neighbourhood
the django checkout (data/repos/django) and data/instances/ref_cache.json — needed only to reproduce headline numbers via the build scripts (scripts/graph_delta.py, not to run the CLI
